$comment: Reviewed baseline of every privileged object the Data API can reach. scripts/check-database-security.mjs fails when the live surface differs from this file, so widening it is a deliberate, reviewable act rather than an incidental line in a migration. Classifications: A = guarded (checks a capability of its own); B = converted to SECURITY INVOKER; C = internal/private (no grant to an exposed role); D = justifiably exempt, with the evidence in docs/POLYTOS-SECURITY-RISK-INVENTORY.md. Every entry needs a classification and a reason. Regenerate with --update after review; never to make a failure go away.

company_identity.reason: Reviewed exemption, 20261106000300. security_invoker = off is deliberate: company_settings requires settings:view to read, so invoker mode returns zero rows for every borrower and breaks receipts and the forced-password recovery screen — measured on a clean database, not assumed. The controls are the fourteen-column published projection (no registration or tax number) and a SELECT-only grant, both asserted in tests/db/security-definer-surface.test.ts and by this gate, because the view is auto-updatable and a write grant would bypass company_settings RLS.
